The '''''Gladius''-class light freighter''' was a sleek, fast and nimble craft. It was used by defense forces and [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] as a scout vessel or system patrol craft.

==Characteristics==
[[File:RaiderOssus-Legacy2006-10.jpg|thumb|left|The rear of a ''Gladius''-class light freighter.]]
''Gladius''-class freighter had a round, flat vertical section and smooth, curved body design. It also had a circular cockpit area that allowed for easy movement between stations. It was armed with an impressive quad laser cannon, but did not possess enough defense to withstand attacks by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and other criminals. Its fast [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] allowed the vessels to escape from most attackers and reach safety.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
[[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] made a deal with [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] that allowed [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] to manufacture these ships despite Imperial restrictions in exchange for favorable contracts on manufacture of the Imperial vessels. [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] used ''Gladius''-class freighters as long-range scout craft. It was also popular with bounty hunters who appreciated its speed, armament and ease of operations. [[Jor Torlin]], an agent of [[Sith Intelligence and Assassination]], owned a ''Gladius'' known as the [[Raider (Gladius-class)|''Raider'']].<ref name="LECG" />
